PROP-56ad1eb2-pre-005.text: Public key point (qx,qy) must lie on the secp256r1 curve and not be the point at infinity.
PROP-56ad1eb2-pre-005.assertion: forall p256verify(h,r,s,qx,qy): (qy^2 == qx^3+a*qx+b mod p) AND (qx,qy)!=(0,0)
